summary: {director} brings the rate for an outside tournament to a hearing about ordinary players' prices.
realLife: Portland council singled out organized golf outings as a source of additional revenue while asking parks staff to limit increases for younger and older players.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: an outing rate, youth rate and bookings by category.

turns.pulledBy: Tournament bookings can cover more of the target at the proposed higher rate.
turns.what: The director costs an outing-only increase.
turns.writesBack: The rate sheet separates group bookings.

turns.pulledBy: The council lowers the outing rate to keep an event.
turns.what: The director recalculates the transfer using the organizer's confirmed booking.
turns.writesBack: The forecast distinguishes booked rounds from hoped-for ones.
